description:
This beautiful, durable Three-wheeler is ideal for parents to ride with their younger children behind them. Super Sturdy with Drum Brake and THREE SPEED Coaster Brake. FUN, FUN, FUN!!!!

Now there's a brand new Worksman Cycle for families that know how to have fun. The MVFC-3CB family Chariot is like a personal pedicab. A Pedicab for the healthful, environmentally sensitive, progressive family. One driver can pedal two people around in style! For those purely practical people, this is a great way to transport family members on short trips economically and fuel free while getting great exercise. For those looking for just plain family fun. What a trip! The tricycle features the heavy duty Worksman Stretch Mover Design with dual rear captain seats with fold down armrests (not shown), dual lap-belts (not shown), a 3 speed coaster brake, front drum brake and so much more. Make a statement in your neighborhood! Share great times with your children on the Worksman Family Dual Chariot.
